text:
lee: Quick sync — I have three cross-repo PRs that need an ordered merge and a short rollout window: SDK (redwood/sdk#482) depends on API (redwood/api#1023) and charts (redwood/charts#76). Proposal: 1) api, 2) charts, 3) sdk, 4) console canary. Can folks confirm availability and approvals?

lee: Quick checklist I used locally:
```
- api: redwood/api#1023  (adds optional header behavior)
- charts: redwood/charts#76  (image.tag=canary, new env var)
- runtime: bump kv-cache setting (requires canary runtime config)
- sdk: redwood/sdk#482  (client header compat)
- console: redwood/console#190  (ui toggle for new header)
```

maria: I can take API review tonight. Found one flaky unit test to fix, will push a small test patch.

devon: Heads up — charts CI has been flaky this morning, helm lint failing on templating. Will re-run and fix. Hold helm after API is green if possible.

sam: SDK PR is basically ready, left one compat test request. I can rebase against main+api once merged. If API changes header name we should be fine with a feature-flag fallback.

nina: Console owner here — I can deploy canary after runtime confirms the KV cache bump. I’m free 03:00-04:00 UTC if that works (can monitor logs).

ci-bot: build/redwood/charts#76: CI failed (lint) — templates/deployment.yaml: line 42: mapping values are not allowed here

devon: Re-running lint now, will fix template spacing. ETA 20m.

lee: If helm is delayed we could merge API first and hold SDK until charts are green, but SDK needs the header behavior, so prefer API -> charts -> sdk.

maria: +1 after tests. I’ll ping here when api CI passes.

devon: :thumbsup: lint re-run queued (job 3421).

ci-bot: build/redwood/api#1023: CI passed (unit + integration) — commit 7a1d2f3

sam: Nice. I’ll rebase SDK against main now and run compat test matrix. Planning to merge SDK once API is on main and charts green. Targeting cut at 03:00 UTC.

nina: I’ll schedule console canary for 03:30 UTC and watch metrics + logs for ~30m.

lee: Plan locked for now. If anything blocks after this thread, drop a quick note here (or @lee). Thanks all. :rocket:
